title: Stride
summary: Fitness coaching: plans, workout logs, daily check-ins and coach feedback.
description: A training app where athletes log workouts and daily check-ins and their coach follows along. Athletes see a streak ring and weekly volume; coaches get a roster, each athlete's history and a feedback thread. Rules allow one check-in a day and no workouts in the future.
roles_summary: Athletes sign up. Coaches follow their athletes.
includes: Athlete home with streak ring and weekly volume chart
highlights: Rules: one check-in a day, no future workouts
